deadline.intake: September 2027, UCAS deadline for all UK/EU/international applicants (non-medicine)

tuition.note: international, standard degrees, 'from' indicative 2026 fee; 2027 TBC; lab/studio degrees 36,800

requirement.text: Uzbek school certificate is not accepted for direct entry; applicants need A Levels, IB or SAT/ACT/AP, or the one-year International Foundation Programme (certificate with 70%+ average). English requirements vary by programme (e.g. IELTS 6.5 with 5.5 per component for some).
